- Net sales = £960,000.00 − £24,000.00 = £936,000.00
- Cost of goods sold = £85,000.00 + £570,000.00 − £95,000.00 = £560,000.00
- Gross profit = £936,000.00 − £560,000.00 = £376,000.00
- Gross margin = £376,000.00 ÷ £936,000.00 × 100 = 40.17%
- Operating expenses = £140,000.00 + £42,000.00 + £18,000.00 + £22,000.00 = £222,000.00
- Operating profit = £376,000.00 − £222,000.00 = £154,000.00
- Finance costs = £9,000.00 = £9,000.00
- Profit before tax = £154,000.00 − £9,000.00 interest = £145,000.00
